marta_ellison.voice: Dry flour. Short sentences. Pretends practicality is a personality.
marta_ellison.tellGivenUp: Cloth over the dough four days; she dusts the counter instead of lifting it.

methods.challenge: You want a fight with yeast? Fine. Heat's a kind of argument.
methods.shame: Say it. Call me lazy. The bread still won't rise for spite.
methods.inspire: …Someone ate. Alright. Flour. Water. Don't watch.
methods.carry_burden: Your hands are bigger. Doesn't mean the dough forgives you.
methods.lie: Tomorrow's full of customers? Sure. Lie closer to the oven.

marks.dependence: Come back tomorrow or the oven forgets how.
marks.hollowness: I'm baking. Don't ask if I mean it.
marks.genuine_growth: Steam's real. So am I, for now.
marks.fragile_hope: One loaf. Don't make a parade.

marta_ellison.driftHint: City folk buy bread like it's a rumor. Used to be they knew the crust.
marta_ellison.cityKinHint: Cousin Priya's still on the strand. Farther kin went into the glare and stopped writing recipes.

jonah_pike.voice: Quiet, precise, afraid of being seen; sharper than adults expect.
jonah_pike.tellGivenUp: Pencil idle on a blank bird; he erases lines that aren't there.

methods.challenge: You can't dare a blank page. …Okay. One wing.
methods.shame: …I don't want that word. Please pick another.
methods.inspire: Somebody else made a thing and lived. Fine. Bad bird. Mine.
methods.carry_burden: You held the paper still. That's… not nothing.
methods.lie: Nobody will laugh? People always laugh. But— okay.

marks.dependence: Don't leave before I finish the eye.
marks.hollowness: I drew it. Looking still hurts.
marks.resentment: You were loud. The page flinched.
marks.fragile_hope: Maybe Ruth won't say it's wrong.

jonah_pike.driftHint: Grown-ups talk about the city like a monster under the bed. I just hate being looked at.
jonah_pike.cityKinHint: Mama says auntie went where the lights never sleep. I drew it once. Erased it.

harold_finch.voice: Exhausted father; humor like a bruise; hates pity.
harold_finch.woundLine: The floor asks less than the boots.
harold_finch.tellGivenUp: Boots by the door laced for nobody; afternoon light on an unmade bed.

methods.challenge: You calling me soft? Get out of the way of the boots.
methods.shame: I know. The kids know. Saying it louder doesn't feed them.
methods.inspire: Someone else stood up. Annoying. Pass me the left boot.
methods.carry_burden: You don't get to carry my kids. You can haul me to the yard.
methods.lie: It gets easier? Don't sell me weather. Just— hand me the lace.

marks.dependence: If you're not here at dawn I stay horizontal.
marks.resentment: You dragged me. My knees kept the receipt.

harold_finch.driftHint: Hardship used to make us stand. Now it just makes the floor look honest.
harold_finch.cityKinHint: Wife took river work toward the cities. Letters slowed like cooling bread.

ruth_calder.voice: Precise, bitter, still a teacher even when she hates the lesson.
ruth_calder.tellGivenUp: Bell rope untouched; chalk tin closed like a held breath.

methods.challenge: Argue with the county, not me— …Fine. One sentence on the board.
methods.shame: Low priority. I heard it. You don't get to grade me with it.
methods.inspire: Proof, not sermons. Show me someone kept a promise.
methods.carry_burden: Ring it yourself if you must. I'll write after the sound dies.
methods.lie: Funding's coming? Ink that lie elsewhere.

marks.dependence: Come back when the chalk runs out.
marks.hollowness: Class is open. I am not.
marks.genuine_growth: We are not done. I wrote it. I meant it.
marks.resentment: You scraped the wound for sport.

ruth_calder.driftHint: They speak for counties that never sat in these desks. Representation without recognition is just noise.
ruth_calder.cityKinHint: Leon writes from the strand. The city inspectors write from nowhere I can teach.

elias_boone.voice: Grief like banked coal; talks to the absent brother without saying the name.
elias_boone.woundLine: He took the heat with him.
elias_boone.tellGivenUp: Forge dark; orders on a nail; he sits where sparks used to land.

methods.challenge: You want noise? Bellows. He was better. I'm what's left.
methods.shame: Shame me for mourning and I'll forge you a quieter mouth.
methods.inspire: A warm thing someone else made. …Alright. Coal.
methods.carry_burden: Haul the iron. I'll find his rhythm or invent a worse one.

marks.dependence: Don't let the fire die when you leave.
marks.hollowness: Nails for sale. Heart not included.
marks.genuine_growth: Still warm. He'd hate my form. Good.
marks.resentment: You kicked the damper open. Ash went everywhere.
marks.fragile_hope: One nail. Then maybe a hinge.

clara_whitby.voice: Shopkeeper steel; old guilt polished daily; dry as inventory.
clara_whitby.woundLine: They forgot the theft. I didn't.
clara_whitby.tellGivenUp: Shutters nailed from inside; ledger slammed; she pretends not to hear knocks.

methods.challenge: Open it or I will. Credit's uglier in the dark.
methods.shame: Call me thief again. I've rehearsed the bow.
methods.inspire: Light on the books. If I'm guilty, at least I'm legible.
methods.carry_burden: Pry the nails. I'll face the first customer.
methods.lie: Absolved? Save that for church. Hand me the crowbar.

marks.dependence: Stand by the door when they come.
marks.genuine_growth: Ledger's honest. So is the flour this time.

clara_whitby.driftHint: When Mira's letters started sounding like another country, I nailed the shutters.
clara_whitby.cityKinHint: My sister lives where the days don't match ours. I still owe her a true ledger line.

nora_voss.voice: Midwife practical; soft where it counts; haunted by a quiet that wasn't hers.
nora_voss.tellGivenUp: Bag by the door unopened; kettle cold; she flinches at knocks.

methods.challenge: You think fear is unprofessional? Watch me pack anyway.
methods.shame: Shame won't un-quiet a child. Choose another tool.
methods.inspire: Someone else answered a door. I can hate that and still go.
methods.carry_burden: Carry the bag. I'll carry the part that shakes.
methods.lie: It won't happen again? Don't. Just walk with me.

marks.dependence: If the ferry fails again I need you on the rope.
marks.hollowness: I'll deliver. Don't ask what I feel.
marks.resentment: You treated my grief like a lesson.

samir_okafor.voice: Ex-port wit gone flat; music metaphors he half-resents.
samir_okafor.tellGivenUp: Fiddle cased; he drinks where music used to stand.

methods.challenge: Dare me to make noise? Three notes. Walls can sue me.
methods.shame: Lazy? I'm tired of performing hope. …Fine. Tune.
methods.inspire: Heard a phrase that wasn't dead. Annoying. Pass the bow.
methods.carry_burden: You keep time. I'll pretend the room deserves it.
methods.lie: They'll dance again? Sell it softer.

marks.hollowness: I played. Clap if you need to feel useful.
marks.resentment: You tuned me like a tool.

tom_briggs.voice: Old ferryman; invents weather; guilt about Nora's storm sits in his coat.
tom_briggs.tellGivenUp: Ferry unlaunched; rope soft with salt; he watches both shores like debts.

methods.challenge: Call me yellow and untie it yourself— …No. My hands. Push off.
methods.shame: I know whose crossing I missed. Shame's already passenger.
methods.inspire: Someone else kept moving. Rope's wet. Hands still know.
methods.carry_burden: You haul the ramp. I'll take the current.
methods.lie: Safe as houses? River eats houses. Cast off anyway.

marks.dependence: Stay on the gunwale till we dock.
marks.genuine_growth: Wake behind us. Nora can knock again.
marks.resentment: You shoved my fear like cargo.

priya_sen.voice: Tired grower; dirt under nails even when she stopped; wry with plants.
priya_sen.woundLine: People stopped being hungry for tomorrow.
priya_sen.tellGivenUp: Plot a fist of thistle; seed packets yellow in a tin; sleeps in the shed.

methods.challenge: Argue with dirt, then. Thistle first.
methods.shame: I worked harder when demand died. Shame's late.
methods.inspire: Green somewhere else. Fine. One row.
methods.carry_burden: You clear. I'll plant what still believes in water.
methods.lie: Markets coming back? Plant anyway. Lying to seeds is free.

marks.hollowness: Sprouts for sale. Hope not stocked.
marks.genuine_growth: First green. I'll fight for the second.
marks.resentment: You treated my plot like a metaphor.

leon_march.voice: Organizer bitterness; ink-stained; believes paper can be an oath.
leon_march.tellGivenUp: Notice board bare wood; he stands beside it like a fired guard.

methods.challenge: Post it or I will. Jobs exist when someone swears they do.
methods.shame: Disorderly? I mediated. You want shame, bill the magistrate.
methods.inspire: Show me a kept notice. Then I write.
methods.carry_burden: Hold the board steady. I'll risk the ink.
methods.lie: County approved? Don't forge seals. Forge work.

marks.dependence: Stand when they tear it down.
marks.hollowness: Notices up. I'm not reading them.
marks.genuine_growth: Ink. Paper. An oath with a nail.
marks.resentment: You used my board like a prop.

leon_march.driftHint: I posted work for hands the city stopped counting as real.
leon_march.cityKinHint: Ruth still rings a bell I can hear on paper. The Reach does not.

mira_whitby.voice: Cool, tired, precise; misses home without knowing how to say dirt.
mira_whitby.woundLine: Home and here stopped meaning the same hardship.
mira_whitby.tellGivenUp: Unanswered letters from Clara stacked under a glass paperweight.
mira_whitby.driftHint: We used to rise together. Then our days stopped rhyming.
mira_whitby.cityKinHint: Clara thinks I abandoned Ashford. I think Ashford abandoned time.

methods.challenge: Argue with the Reach if you want. I have a shift.
methods.shame: Shame me for leaving. I already did, yearly.
methods.inspire: A letter that sounds like home? …I will answer one.
methods.carry_burden: You cannot carry my city day. Carry the stamp to the post.
methods.lie: I'll visit spring? Don't. Write true instead.

marks.dependence: Keep writing or I vanish into glare.
marks.hollowness: I answered. Do not call it love.
marks.genuine_growth: One true page. Ashford might still be real.
marks.resentment: You used my absence as a sermon.
marks.fragile_hope: One letter. No promises of roads.

refusal_shame_child: Shame? On a cub? No. The coal in me won't take that air.
I could break him with a word. That's why I won't.
He's small. My voice isn't. Put it away.
refusal_gaze_child: I don't need eyes like knives for a child. Look elsewhere.

refusal_shame_child: I will not put that in the book. Children are not ledgers.
Cross it out. We do not shame the unfinished.
Ink has rules. That word stops at the schoolyard.
refusal_burn_ledger: I will not burn a ledger to win a soul. Find another cut.

refusal_shame_child: We will not look at the small one that way.
Our voices together could crush him. That is why we stay quiet.
refusal_gaze_child: Not the child. Soften the eyes. Gaze elsewhere.
Three pairs of eyes. None of them for scaring cubs.

loreHints: driftHint + cityKinHint optional but encouraged for authored cast
